newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide profits up 21 pct in latest quarter.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide profits up 21 pct in latest quarter.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp. Monday reported a 21 percent rise in second-quarter profits, with the chemicals and plastics maker attributing the gain to lower raw material costs.
It earned $188 million, or $1.28 a share, up from $155 million, or $1.03 a share, in last year's second quarter.
Sales rose to $1.66 billion from $1.55 billion.

"Improved pricing for polyethylene and ethylene glycol, and lower raw material costs compared to the first quarter, accounted for most of the second-quarter gains," said Chief Executive Officer William H. Joyce.
Union Carbide's stock was off 6 cents at $50.19 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
